summary: Strategem is a Bendigo-headquartered firm (history from 1932) with a Melbourne CBD office, about 65 staff and nine directors, covering accounting, tax, business advisory, wealth management and audit. Managing Partner Chris Harrington appeared on the firm's Enriched Wealth podcast in July 2025 and describes advising small to medium businesses in Central Victoria. Fit is moderate to weak because the firm is tax and wealth focused.

hooks.text: Chris's July 2025 podcast remark that owners are worn out by the time the books are due, and that the firm should make it easier, maps directly to reconciliation.
Chris spoke about the firm's recent IT changeover and daily reliance on IT, a sign of openness to tooling.

risks.text: Tax, wealth and audit oriented; Daniel Nalder is a financial adviser. No bookkeeping or outsourced CFO service listed, so fit is weak to moderate.
Chris says he is not an IT expert; tooling decisions may sit with others.

first.subject: Reconciliation at Strategem
first.body:
Hi Chris,

Saw your Enriched Wealth episode on building, growing and exiting a business, and your point that by the time owners have to do the books they are already worn out, so the more your team can take off them the better. That is the problem I built Vert for. It turns hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a traceable audit trail rather than AI that guesses. How much of your business services team's month goes on reconciling small and medium clients' books? Open to a 10 min walkthrough?
Best,
Dawoud
